answer.question: What is the total electricity consumption for FY 2024-25, and how complete is the data?
answer.answer: The total electricity consumption for FY 2024-25 cannot be given as a single figure because the data comes from two different organisations and covers only a small fraction of the year. For Adani Electricity Mumbai Limited, the total consumption is 47,407 kWh (reported) from April 2024 only. For BESCOM, the total consumption is 63,000 kWh (reported) from the billing period 2024-06-01 to 2024-07-01 (covering June and one day of July). The data is highly incomplete: only 2 months of the 12-month financial year are represented, and from separate entities.

gaps: For Adani Electricity Mumbai Limited: missing months are May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December 2024, January, February, March 2025.
For BESCOM: missing months are April, May, August, September, October, November, December 2024, January, February, March 2025; July is partial (only 1 day covered).
No other electricity consumption data for FY 2024-25 was found in the provided documents.
assumptions: The BESCOM billing period 2024-06-01 to 2024-07-01 is treated as covering June 2024 and one day of July 2024; the consumption of 63,000 kWh is for that entire period.
The two organisations are separate; their totals are not summed.

answer.question: Who does the Nestlé quality policy apply to, who approved it and when, and what does it commit to?
answer.answer: The Nestlé Food Safety and Quality Policy applies to all employees, was approved by the Executive Board of Nestlé S.A. in June 2026, and commits to four principles: (1) Food Safety and Compliance are Non‑Negotiable, (2) Quality enables Unrivaled Product Superiority, (3) Quality is End‑to‑End, and (4) Food Safety and Quality are Everyone’s Responsibility.

citations.quote: We never compromise on food safety and compliance. We adhere to internationally recognized food safety management systems and comply with legal, regulatory, and internal requirements. Our commitment is unwavering: to deliver safe and nutritious products that strengthen trust in our brands and our company - every day, in every market.

Powered by Nestlé’s long history of expertise and robust science and technology capabilities, quality is the cornerstone of our ambition to achieve unrivaled product superiority. We take ownership, make deliberate choices, and aim to deliver the best consumer and customer experience, making sure that the quality we design is the quality we deliver.

Quality is embedded across the entire value chain, from ideation to responsibly sourced ingredients, manufacturing, packaging, and delivery to the point of consumption. At every phase, we ensure excellence in execution.

Each of us plays a vital role in delivering our promise of food safety and quality in the products we make. We foster a culture where every individual is empowered and expected to act, speak up, drive continuous improvement - and is recognized for their contributions.
